briefings.title: Waymo Co-CEO Dmitri Dolgov: The Demo Is Only 1% Of The Work
briefings.tldr: Building physical AI requires bridging a massive gap between a working demo (1% of the work) and a reliable real-world product (the remaining 99%), demanding rigorous safety frameworks, multi-sensor hardware redundancy, and closed-loop simulation.

briefings.title: The 20-year journey to fully autonomous cars with Dmitri Dolgov of Waymo
briefings.tldr: Waymo has transitioned from a 20-year scientific research phase to a massive global scaling operation, now delivering 500,000 autonomous rides weekly by utilizing a unified AI backbone that distills massive off-board foundation models into specialized on-board "drivers."

briefings.title: Waymo Co-CEO on the Road to 1 Million Robotaxi Rides a Week
briefings.tldr: Waymo has secured a $5.6 billion funding round at a $45 billion valuation to fuel global expansion, targeting a milestone of 1 million weekly paid rides by the end of 2025 while advocating for a unified federal regulatory framework.

briefings.title: Tesla and Waymo execs testify before Senate panel on the future of self-driving cars — 2/4/26
briefings.tldr: The Senate hearing underscored a bipartisan consensus for a federal framework for autonomous vehicles (AVs) to enhance safety, promote American innovation, and secure jobs, while addressing critical concerns around federal oversight, data privacy, liability, and ensuring equitable access and workforce protection.
